title: The Ledger of Small Mercies
setting_summary: A cramped river-town customs house where every citizen's daily ration, movement, and spoken word is tallied in ledgers by a bored but relentless bureaucracy. A missing page in the master ledger threatens to erase one resident entirely, forcing the clerks and neighbors to argue over who counts, who decides, and what a person is worth when the ink runs out.
